usage: cox stats examples [-h] --role ROLE [--out OUT] [--since SINCE] [runs_dir]

positional arguments:
  runs_dir

options:
  -h, --help     show this help message and exit
  --role ROLE    handoff or review_charter; repeat for several
  --out OUT      write the file to PATH (default: stdout)
  --since SINCE  keep only records dated on or after DATE (YYYY-MM-DD)
